SELECT ut.*, c.course_name AS courseName, t.name AS teacherName, cl.class_name AS className, b.batch_no AS batchNo FROM unscheduled_task ut LEFT JOIN teaching_task tt ON ut.task_id = tt.id AND tt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course c ON tt.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON tt.teacher_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN class_info cl ON tt.class_id = cl.id AND cl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN auto_schedule_batch b ON ut.batch_id = b.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND ut.batch_id = #{batchId}
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
AND cl.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%')
AND ut.reason_type = #{reasonType}
ORDER BY ut.create_time DESC
